'
Til I Can Make It on My Own
is the fifteenth studio album by American country music singer-songwriter
Tammy Wynette
. It was released on March 8, 1976, by
Epic Records
.
[
3
]
[
4
]
Commercial performance
The album peaked at No. 3 on the
Billboard
Country Albums
chart. The album's only single,
"
'Til I Can Make It on My Own", peaked at No. 1 on the
Billboard
Country Singles
chart.
Album Notes
"Easy Come, Easy Go" is a
Dobie Gray
cover from his 1975 album,
New Ray of Sunshine
.  Wynette also recorded a completely different song also called "Easy Come, Easy Go" on her 1981 album,
You Brought Me Back
, which is a
Mama Cass Elliot
cover from her 1969 album,
Bubblegum, Lemonade, and... Something for Mama
.
